Adds a Docker image, a listing in the official MCP Registry and a sender summary tool.

- **Sender summary:** the new `summarizeSenders` tool counts local messages by sender address or
  domain, with dates and folders. See
  [Sender counts](https://github.com/igorolv/mail-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/search.md#sender-counts).
- **Sender filter:** `search` and `summarizeSenders` accept `from`, one complete sender address, which
  combines with a text query.
- **Docker image:** `ghcr.io/igorolv/mail-mcp-server`, with Java and pandoc included. See
  [Docker](https://github.com/igorolv/mail-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/clients.md#docker). In a
  container, passwords come from `connections.json` or an environment variable: Windows Credential
  Manager is not available.
- **MCP Registry:** listed as `io.github.igorolv/mail-mcp-server`.
- **Sync survives local file errors:** a write that fails briefly, for example while an antivirus
  holds the file, is retried, and so is the download or conversion of one message. When a sync does
  fail on a local error, `mail-sync` and the server log show the full stack trace.
- **No more stuck `running` status:** `syncStatus` reports `interrupted` when the sync it describes
  is no longer running, which happened when several clients shared one data directory.
- **Less memory while idle:** the server returns heap memory to the operating system after a
  background sync ends.

The jar remains the recommended way to run the server on Windows.
